Fixed Tab in shell mode filling in a file name after `&&`, `;` or `|`, where a command goes
Fixed question dialogs naming ctrl+g after the external editor key was rebound

title.zh-TW: 停止背景工作與關閉指令選單的按鍵修復
title.en: Key Fixes for Stopping Background Tasks and Closing Menus

body.zh-TW:
按快捷鍵想停掉正在跑的工作或退出列表，過去常遇到卡住不給退或一次誤停兩件的窘境，這幾個關閉手勢現在都改準了。

在 `/tasks` 的任務詳情頁連按兩下 `x` 時，不再順便把下一個任務也停掉。在 `/chrome` 的瀏覽器清單畫面連按兩次 `Ctrl+C`，現在也能順利關閉離開。

執行 `/autofix-pr` 後按下 `Esc`，畫面不再卡住鍵盤乾等雲端工作階段停止，對話框會立刻關掉。若停止失敗，事後還會附上連結向你回報。
body.en:
Pressing a shortcut to stop a running task or exit a list used to freeze or stop two items by mistake, and those close actions now work accurately.

Pressing `x` twice on a task's details page in `/tasks` no longer stops the next task as well. Pressing `Ctrl+C` twice on the browser list screen in `/chrome` now closes it properly.

Pressing `Esc` after running `/autofix-pr` no longer locks the keyboard while waiting for the cloud session to stop; the dialog closes immediately. If stopping fails, it reports back afterwards with a link.

items.original:
Fixed a second `x` on a task's details in `/tasks` stopping the next task too
Fixed `/autofix-pr` holding the keyboard after Esc while it stopped the cloud session; the dialog now closes at once, and a stop that fails is reported afterwards with a link
Fixed Ctrl+C twice not closing `/chrome` from its browser list

title.zh-TW: 指令選單重複項目與游標記憶等操作改善
title.en: Improvements for Slash Menu Duplicates and Cursor Position

body.zh-TW:
打開各種斜線指令選單挑項目，列表的捲動與點選反應比以前順手得多。

資料列較晚才載入完成的清單，不再偶爾忽略 Enter 與方向鍵。`/` 選單面對同名技能時，不再每筆都列出來卻永遠只執行第一個。

在 `/mcp` 與 `/plugin` 點進某個 MCP 工具再返回列表時，游標會保留在原本的位置，不再搞丟目前所在處。執行 `/desktop` 時，下載詢問也從原本的 `y/n` 換成標準清單選項。
body.en:
Scrolling and selecting items across slash command menus now feels much smoother.

Lists that load their rows late no longer occasionally ignore Enter and the arrow keys. When the `/` menu has skills with the same name, it no longer lists every entry while always running only the first.

When you open an MCP tool in `/mcp` or `/plugin` and return to the list, the cursor stays in its previous position instead of losing your place. Running `/desktop` also replaces the `y/n` download prompt with a standard list selection.

items.original:
Fixed lists that load their rows late sometimes ignoring Enter and the arrow keys
Fixed the `/` menu listing a row for each skill of the same name, though every row ran the first
Fixed the MCP tool list in `/mcp` and `/plugin` losing your place when going back from a tool
Improved `/desktop`: the download question is a standard list instead of y/n

title.zh-TW: VS Code 檔案總管右鍵新增加入對話功能
title.en: Add to Chat Right-Click Action in VS Code Explorer

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 側邊欄看到幾個相關檔案想請 Claude 一起讀，以前還得切回輸入框手動打 `@` 慢慢挑。現在只要在檔案總管選好檔案或資料夾並按右鍵，點擊 `"Claude Code: Add to Chat"`，就會直接把它們用 `@` 標記帶進對話裡。⟦跟逛網拍直接勾選多件商品丟進購物車一樣，不必切換分頁自己一筆一筆打品名。⟧
body.en: When you spot related files in the VS Code sidebar that you want Claude to read together, you used to have to switch back to the input box and type `@` to pick them one by one. Now you can select files or folders in the Explorer, right-click, and choose `"Claude Code: Add to Chat"` to bring them straight into the chat as `@` mentions. ⟦Checking off multiple items online and tossing them straight into a cart beats switching tabs to type each product name by hand.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added "Claude Code: Add to Chat" to the Explorer's right-click menu, which @-mentions the selected files and folders in the chat

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版移除未使用的舊 IDE 連線工具
title.en: VS Code extension removes unused legacy IDE connection tools

body.zh-TW: 這項變動屬於底層連線整理，給想了解 VS Code 擴充套件與編輯器溝通內容的開發者與使用者參考。Claude Code 與 IDE 的連線裡正式移除了幾個長期沒在使用的舊工具（包含開檔、存檔與取得開啟中編輯器清單等相關功能）。⟦如同整理工程車後車廂，把幾件多年沒派上用場的備用零件清下車，工具箱更俐落。⟧
body.en: This change is a low-level connection cleanup for developers and users who want to know how the VS Code extension communicates with the editor. Several long-unused legacy tools (including opening files, saving documents, getting the list of open editors, and related features) have been officially removed from the connection between Claude Code and the IDE. ⟦Clearing out a utility truck's trunk by unloading spare parts that sat untouched for years leaves the toolbox much leaner.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Removed unused tools from the IDE connection (openFile, saveDocument, getOpenEditors and related)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 編輯差異檢視不受中斷也不秀舊提案
title.en: VS Code diff views stay open without interruption or stale proposals

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 同時開著側邊欄聊天和內建終端機寫程式，審核 Claude 的改檔差異最怕畫面被搶走或顯示舊版。現在同一視窗裡的終端機工作階段送出提示詞時，聊天視窗正在看的修改差異會維持開啟並繼續等你確認，不會被中斷關閉。

另外在終端機工作階段的差異畫面手動輸入內容後，如果 Claude 再次編輯同一份檔案，畫面現在會顯示最新的修改內容，不再錯秀成上一輪的舊提案。⟦就像同時開著兩條生產線核對設計圖，別桌同事喊了一聲，你手上的比對螢幕依然亮著等你簽字，新改的圖紙也會即時換上去。⟧
body.en:
When coding in VS Code with both the sidebar chat and the integrated terminal open, the last thing you want while reviewing Claude's file diffs is losing focus or seeing an outdated version. Now, when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt, any chat edit diff you are viewing stays open and continues waiting for your approval instead of closing abruptly.

Additionally, after you type manually in a terminal session's diff view, if Claude edits the same file again, the screen now displays the latest changes rather than mistakenly showing the previous round's proposal. ⟦Two production lines run side by side for blueprint checks, and when a colleague at another desk calls out, your comparison monitor stays lit waiting for your sign-off while newly revised drawings swap in right away.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a terminal session's diff showing the previous proposed edit after you typed in it and Claude edited the same file again
[VSCode] Changed a chat edit's diff to stay open and keep asking for approval when a terminal session in the same window sends a prompt

title.zh-TW: VS Code 權限視窗與彈出選單顯示及按鍵修復
title.en: VS Code fixes for permission prompts, popups, and Escape key

body.zh-TW:
VS Code 彈出權限確認框或你想按 `Esc` 關掉小選單，過去常遇到關鍵訊息被裁掉，或是一按就把 Claude 回到一半的對話整段喊停。

當 `PreToolUse` hook 要求確認時，權限視窗現在會正常顯示它提供的理由；太長的工具名稱或檔案名稱在視窗標題上也不再被截斷。

按 `Esc` 關閉回饋視窗、`"Build a custom style"` 對話框、`@` 標記選單，或是模型、模式、`+` 等彈出選單時，不再順便把正在進行的 Claude 回覆一併中止。
body.en:
When a VS Code permission prompt popped up or you pressed `Esc` to close a small menu, key details used to get cut off, or a single keypress would halt Claude's mid-flight response.

When a `PreToolUse` hook asks for confirmation, the permission prompt now properly displays the reason it provides, and overly long tool or file names are no longer truncated in the prompt title.

Pressing `Esc` to close the feedback dialog, the `"Build a custom style"` dialog, the `@`-mention menu, or popups such as the model, mode, and `+` menus no longer stops Claude's ongoing response at the same time.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt not showing the reason that a PreToolUse hook gives when it asks for confirmation (anthropics/claude-code#85950)
[VSCode] Fixed long tool and file names being cut off in a permission prompt's title
[VSCode] Fixed Escape also stopping Claude's response when it closes the feedback or "Build a custom style" dialog, the @-mention menu, the model, mode or "+" menu, or another popup

title.zh-TW: VS Code 連續改檔與搜尋及啟動速度提升
title.en: VS Code speeds up consecutive edits, search, and startup

body.zh-TW:
在大型專案工作區用 VS Code 擴充功能，或是剛打開新資料夾準備開工，這版把幾項等待感明顯的步驟都調快了。

Claude 連續進行多次編輯時，排隊中的編輯會共用一次等待新診斷問題的時間，而某些問題可能會延後到較後面那次編輯才一起回報。

當系統 `PATH` 內有 `rg` 時，大型工作區裡的 `@` 檔案搜尋速度加快，排序方式變得更像終端機版，但對打錯字的容錯度會降低一些。

除了第三方服務提供者之外，首次開啟的資料夾、空白視窗與 worktree 現在一打開就能立刻點選模型選單。
body.en:
When using the VS Code extension in large workspaces or opening a new folder to get started, this release speeds up several steps where waiting used to be noticeable.

When Claude makes several edits in a row, queued edits share a single wait for new diagnostic problems, and some issues may be reported together with a later edit.

When `rg` is available on your system `PATH`, `@` file search in large workspaces is faster and ranks results more like the terminal version, though with slightly less tolerance for typos.

Except on third-party providers, folders opened for the first time, empty windows, and worktrees now let you open and select from the model picker right away.

items.original:
[VSCode] Improved speed when Claude makes several edits in a row: queued edits share one wait for new problems; a problem may be reported with a later edit
[VSCode] Improved @-mention file search speed in large workspaces when `rg` is on your `PATH`; results now rank much as in the terminal, with less tolerance for typos
[VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker is ready at once in folders opened for the first time, empty windows and worktrees, except on third-party providers

title.zh-TW: TUI 即時語音支援 WebRTC 協商
title.en: TUI Realtime Voice Supports WebRTC Negotiation

body.zh-TW:
改報告或查資料雙手正忙，想直接開口通話而不想切出視窗，現在待在 TUI（終端機文字操作介面）裡也能辦到。

新版為 TUI 裡的即時語音通話加入了 WebRTC（網頁即時通訊協定）協商功能，負責處理通話建立前的連線溝通。⟦好比兩個人約好在吵雜車站會合，以前只能靠文字傳訊慢慢喬，現在先對好語音頻道就能直接開口對話。⟧
body.en:
When your hands are busy editing a report or looking up information and you want to speak directly without switching windows, you can now stay right inside the TUI (terminal text interface).

This release adds WebRTC (a real-time web communication protocol) negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI, handling connection setup before a call starts. ⟦Think of two people meeting at a noisy train station: before, they had to coordinate slowly by text, whereas now they can agree on a voice channel first and speak directly.⟧

items.original: Added WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI. (#61172)

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 匯出器自動更新驗證標頭
title.en: OpenTelemetry Exporters Automatically Refresh Authentication Headers

body.zh-TW: 給有串接 OpenTelemetry（開放式遙測資料標準）的開發者與管理者。新版為 OpenTelemetry HTTP 匯出器加入了自動更新驗證標頭的功能，不再一直沿用同一組舊的驗證資訊。⟦跟進出園區的通行 QR Code 一樣，以前得自己定期重開頁面領新條碼，現在手上的這張會自動換成最新版本。⟧
body.en: For developers and administrators who integrate OpenTelemetry (an observability data standard). This release adds automatic authentication header refreshes for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters instead of reusing the same old authentication details. ⟦Picture a campus entry QR code: previously you had to reopen the page periodically to get a new code, whereas now the one you hold updates to the latest version automatically.⟧

items.original: Added automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters. (#61028)

title.zh-TW: 不同環境可共用同名的 MCP 伺服器
title.en: Different Environments Can Share Identically Named MCP Servers

body.zh-TW:
你在測試環境和正式環境各自接了外部服務，卻因為兩邊的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器取了相同名字而打架嗎？

新版加入了實驗性支援，允許你在不同環境裡使用同名的 MCP 伺服器。⟦比方說家裡跟公司各有一間都叫「文件庫」的儲藏室，以前同名字會搞混，現在只要在不同場所就能各自掛上同樣的門牌。⟧
body.en:
Have you connected external services in both your test and production environments, only to have their MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) servers clash because they share the same name?

This release adds experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across different environments. ⟦Suppose both your home and your office have a storage room called "Documents": before, identical names caused confusion, whereas now they can share the same nameplate as long as they are in different places.⟧

items.original: Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments. (#60905)

title.zh-TW: 過大 WebSocket 請求改走 HTTP 備援
title.en: Oversized WebSocket Requests Fall Back to HTTP

body.zh-TW:
透過 WebSocket（維持長連線的通訊協定）送出的請求一旦太大，過去還會先做多餘的重試。

現在遇到過大的 WebSocket 請求，會直接改走 HTTP 備援通道，省去不必要的重試步驟。⟦就像寄送超重包裹，以前小貨車明明裝不下還得反覆試塞，現在當場直接轉交大貨車送走。⟧
body.en:
Previously, requests sent over WebSocket (a persistent-connection communication protocol) that were too large would still go through unnecessary retries first.

Now, oversized WebSocket requests fall back directly to HTTP, skipping unnecessary retry steps. ⟦Like shipping an overweight parcel, a small van used to keep trying to squeeze it in even when it clearly would not fit, whereas now the shipment goes straight to a larger truck on the spot.⟧

items.original: Oversized WebSocket requests now fall back to HTTP without unnecessary retries. (#60840, #60841)

title.zh-TW: 修好 MCP 登入登出或取消時的憑證衝突
title.en: Fixed MCP Credential Races During Login, Logout, or Cancellation

body.zh-TW: 幫外部工具授權帳號到一半想喊停，或是進行登入、登出，過去的 MCP 授權憑證容易發生衝突。這個問題已經修好，現在進行 OAuth（常見的帳號授權登入方式）取消、登入或登出，憑證不會再互搶。
body.en: Previously, MCP authorization credentials could conflict if you stopped partway through authorizing an external tool account, or while logging in or out. This issue is fixed, so credentials no longer race during OAuth (a standard account authorization method) cancellation, login, or logout.

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth credential races during cancellation, login, and logout. (#60849, #60981)

title.zh-TW: 雲端對話自動重連並保留恢復中的回合
title.en: Cloud Conversations Auto-Reconnect and Preserve Active Recovery Turns

body.zh-TW:
正盯著雲端對話等它把斷線前的進度接回來，最怕重連完那一輪操作卻沒留下來。

新版改善了雲端對話的自動重新連線表現，而且用戶端重新連上後，正在恢復中的回合會繼續保留。⟦像在線上看影片一樣，以前網路斷掉重連會漏掉緩衝到一半的片段，現在畫面接回來後，那一小段進度依然留著。⟧
body.en:
When watching a Cloud conversation wait to resume progress after a disconnect, the last thing you want is for that turn to disappear once it reconnects.

This release improves automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and keeps active recovery turns intact after clients reconnect. ⟦When streaming a video online, a disconnect used to drop the half-buffered segment upon reconnecting, whereas now that bit of progress stays intact once playback resumes.⟧

items.original: Improved automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and preserved active recovery turns when clients reconnect. (#60969, #61014)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 檔案替換與沙盒權限問題
title.en: Fixed Windows File Replacement and Sandbox Permission Issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上執行檔案替換，過去可能遇到異常而失敗，這個問題已經修好。

沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的安全隔離區）原本的權限設定，過去在 Windows 上可能會遺失，現在會完整保留。

執行期註冊資訊需要復原時，過去在 Windows 上會遇到的異常也已經修好。
body.en:
File replacement on Windows could previously fail due to an error, and this issue is now fixed.

Existing permissions for the sandbox (a security isolation zone that limits program access) could previously be lost on Windows, and they are now preserved.

Errors that previously occurred on Windows when runtime registration information needed recovery are also fixed.

items.original: Fixed Windows file replacement, sandbox permission preservation, and runtime registration recovery. (#60872, #60943, #60944)

title.zh-TW: 修正權限更新與子討論串遺失沙盒限制
title.en: Fixed Permission Updates and Child Threads Losing Sandbox Restrictions

body.zh-TW: 工作到一半臨時調整授權設定，或是從既有對話分岔出新任務繼續跑，原本套用的安全隔離過去可能會跟著失效。這個問題已經修好，現在更新權限或建立子討論串，既有的沙盒限制都會保留下來。
body.en: Previously, adjusting authorization settings mid-task or branching a new task from an existing conversation could cause the applied security isolation to stop taking effect. This issue is fixed, so existing sandbox restrictions are now preserved when updating permissions or creating child threads.

items.original: Fixed permission updates and child threads losing existing sandbox restrictions. (#60936, #61134)

title.zh-TW: 移除重複搜尋結果並修好含空白關鍵字摘要
title.en: Removed Duplicate Search Results and Fixed Snippets for Queries with Whitespace

body.zh-TW:
搜尋檔案的清單裡，過去同一個項目可能重複出現。新版已經移除重複的檔案搜尋結果，每個符合的檔案只會列出一筆。

用帶有空白字元的關鍵字搜尋討論串，過去跳出的搜尋結果摘要會顯示異常，這個問題也已經修好。
body.en:
Previously, the same item could appear more than once in file search results. This release removes duplicate file search results so each matching file is listed only once.

Searching threads with queries that contain whitespace previously caused malformed search result snippets, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Removed duplicate file search results and fixed thread search snippets for queries containing whitespace. (#60845, #60846)

title.zh-TW: 沙盒說明文件補上權限設定檔與檔案規則
title.en: Sandbox Documentation Updated with Permission Profiles and Filesystem Rules

body.zh-TW: 替工作環境規劃隔離邊界，卻不確定不同授權等級怎麼分、路徑存取又該怎麼限制，現在有清楚的官方指南可查。新版更新了沙盒說明文件，補齊權限設定檔與檔案系統規則的介紹。
body.en: If you are setting up isolation boundaries for your workspace and are unsure how authorization levels are divided or how path access should be restricted, there is now a clear official guide to check. This release updates the sandbox documentation with explanations of permission profiles and filesystem rules.

items.original: Updated sandbox documentation to explain permission profiles and filesystem rules. (#61133)

first_title.zh-TW: 本版未列出已驗證的重點更新
first_title.en: No verified highlights listed in this release

entries: Added dragging a subagent's tab from the side panel into the message box in the Remote Control browser view, which adds an `@` mention of that subagent's conversation to your message.

Improved undo in Vim mode to work like Vim: `u` now undoes one command at a time instead of grouping edits made close together, a change that enters Insert mode, such as `cw` or `o`, undoes together with everything you typed before `Esc`, and undoing or redoing an operator such as `dd` or `diw` puts the cursor at the start of the changed text.

Improved `agy plugin validate` so you can check a plugin before you install it: besides a local folder, it now accepts a plugin `.zip` file, an `https://` link to one, or a GitHub repository URL, using `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<branch>/<path>` for a plugin in a subfolder.

Changed file and artifact tabs in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view to open with their sidebar closed, so the file or artifact gets the panel's full width; previously the file tree or artifact list opened on its own whenever the panel was wide enough, and you can still open it with `Toggle sidebar` in the tab's header.

Fixed `/usage`, `/quota`, and `/credits` loading forever or showing an empty quota when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, which has no account quota to show; they are now left out of autocomplete and `/help`, running one explains why and points you to the key's usage in AI Studio, and in `-p` runs they exit with code 2.

Fixed plugins whose `plugin.json` starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM), as some Windows editors save it, not loading even though `agy plugin install` reported success, and `agy plugin validate` rejecting them.
Fixed files larger than a few megabytes, such as photos and videos, failing to upload when you attach them in the Remote Control browser view; attachments up to 20 MB now upload.

Fixed clicking a quote in one of your messages in the Remote Control browser view doing nothing when the quoted passage was too far back in a long conversation to have loaded yet; the view now loads that part of the conversation and scrolls to the passage.
Fixed installing the CLI printing routine progress messages as lines starting with `ERROR: logging before google.Init`, which made a successful install look like it had failed.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁版支援拖曳分頁標記子代理
title.en: Remote Control Supports Dragging Subagent Tabs to Mention Them

body.zh-TW: 一次開了好幾位助手分頭查資料或改報告，想在目前對話裡接著引用其中一位的討論內容，操作有新捷徑。在遠端控制網頁介面，直接把側邊面板裡的子代理（幫你分頭處理任務的助手）分頁拖進訊息輸入框，輸入框就會自動補上 `@` 標記，帶出那個子代理的對話。⟦把同事的名牌直接吸到白板格子上，不用像過去得自己抄寫一長串代號，馬上就能對上誰負責哪一段進度。⟧
body.en: When you have several assistants researching or editing reports in parallel, there is a new shortcut to reference one in your current conversation. In the Remote Control browser view, drag a subagent (an assistant handling separate tasks for you) tab from the side panel into the message box to automatically insert an `@` mention linking that subagent's conversation. ⟦Picture snapping a colleague's nameplate onto a whiteboard slot instead of copying a long ID by hand, immediately matching who owns which part of the work.⟧

items.original: Added dragging a subagent's tab from the side panel into the message box in the Remote Control browser view, which adds an `@` mention of that subagent's conversation to your message.

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式復原改成一次退回一個指令
title.en: Vim Mode Undo Now Reverts One Command at a Time

body.zh-TW:
在 Vim 模式（全靠鍵盤指令編輯文字的操作方式）裡打字改檔，按錯想復原常會把好幾次修改一起抹掉，如今行為終於跟正規 Vim 一樣。

按下 `u` 只會退回單一指令的改動，不再把時間相近的編輯綁在一起撤銷。若用 `cw` 或 `o` 這類指令切進插入模式，復原時會把你在按下 `Esc` 前打的內容一起退掉。復原或重做 `dd`、`diw` 這類操作指令時，游標也會停在被改動文字的開頭。⟦以前按錯想悔棋，裁判會把接連幾步混成一團一次收回；現在照這套棋的規矩來，單步就退一步，起手到喊停的整串動作一起退，手還停在剛動過的那格起點。⟧
body.en:
Undoing a typo while editing in Vim mode (a keyboard-only way to edit text with commands) used to wipe out several edits at once, and now it behaves like standard Vim.

Pressing `u` undoes only a single command instead of grouping edits made close together. If you enter Insert mode with commands like `cw` or `o`, undoing reverts everything you typed before pressing `Esc` together. When undoing or redoing operators like `dd` or `diw`, the cursor also lands at the start of the changed text. ⟦Previously, trying to take back a wrong move meant the referee swept up several consecutive turns in one lump; now the game follows proper rules, taking back one step at a time or an entire sequence from start to stop, leaving your hand on the starting square you just touched.⟧

items.original: Improved undo in Vim mode to work like Vim: `u` now undoes one command at a time instead of grouping edits made close together, a change that enters Insert mode, such as `cw` or `o`, undoes together with everything you typed before `Esc`, and undoing or redoing an operator such as `dd` or `diw` puts the cursor at the start of the changed text.

title.zh-TW: 外掛檢查支援遠端網址並修好載入故障
title.en: Plugin Validation Supports Remote URLs and Fixes Loading Failures

body.zh-TW:
想先驗過網路上的外掛再裝，或遇到裝好卻載不進來的狀況，現在都能順暢處理。

`agy plugin validate` 除了本機資料夾，現在也接受 `.zip` 檔、`https://` 連結或 GitHub 網址。外掛在子資料夾時，改用 `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<branch>/<path>`。

部分 Windows 編輯器會在 `plugin.json` 開頭加 UTF-8 BOM（識別編碼的隱藏字元）。以前這種檔案會被這指令退件，連 `agy plugin install` 顯示成功也載不進來，現在已修好。⟦收到外地寄來的包裹，不用搬進家門就能在門口先驗貨，連清單開頭多了一枚隱藏印記，也不會被退件或收下卻拆不開。⟧
body.en:
Checking an online plugin before installing it, or dealing with an installed plugin that fails to load, now works smoothly.

Besides local folders, `agy plugin validate` now accepts `.zip` files, `https://` links, and GitHub URLs. When a plugin lives in a subfolder, use `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<branch>/<path>` instead.

Some Windows editors add a UTF-8 BOM (a hidden encoding marker character) to the start of `plugin.json`. Previously, such files were rejected by this command and failed to load even when `agy plugin install` reported success, and this is now fixed. ⟦Think of inspecting a parcel from out of town right at the doorstep without bringing it inside, so even an extra hidden stamp at the top of the manifest will not get it rejected or leave it unopenable after delivery.⟧

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` so you can check a plugin before you install it: besides a local folder, it now accepts a plugin `.zip` file, an `https://` link to one, or a GitHub repository URL, using `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<branch>/<path>` for a plugin in a subfolder.
Fixed plugins whose `plugin.json` starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM), as some Windows editors save it, not loading even though `agy plugin install` reported success, and `agy plugin validate` rejecting them.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁的檔案分頁預設收起側欄
title.en: File Tabs in Remote Control Browser View Collapse Sidebar by Default

body.zh-TW: 想在側邊面板專心看內容，以前只要畫面夠寬，旁邊的樹狀清單就會自己跳出來把正文擠窄。現在遠端控制網頁開啟檔案或產出物（AI 產生的獨立成果檔）分頁時，會先把側邊欄收起來，讓內容用滿整個面板寬度。如果想看檔案樹或產出物清單，點分頁頂端的 `Toggle sidebar` 還是能展開。⟦翻開書桌上的資料夾時，以前只要桌面夠寬，旁邊的目錄頁就會自動攤開佔掉一半位子；現在預設先把目錄收進側邊，讓你用整面寬度看正文，需要對照時再手動翻開。⟧
body.en: When you wanted to focus on content in the side panel, the tree list beside it used to pop open on its own and squeeze the main text whenever the window was wide enough. Now, when opening a file or artifact (a standalone output file generated by the AI) tab in the Remote Control browser view, the sidebar starts collapsed so the content fills the full panel width. If you want to see the file tree or artifact list, you can still expand it by clicking `Toggle sidebar` at the top of the tab. ⟦Like opening a folder on a desk where the table of contents used to unfold on its own and take up half the space whenever the desk was wide enough, it now tucks the index aside by default so you can read across the full width and flip it open by hand when you need to cross-check.⟧

items.original: Changed file and artifact tabs in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view to open with their sidebar closed, so the file or artifact gets the panel's full width; previously the file tree or artifact list opened on its own whenever the panel was wide enough, and you can still open it with `Toggle sidebar` in the tab's header.

title.zh-TW: 用 GEMINI_API_KEY 時修好額度查詢空轉
title.en: Fixed Quota Commands Hanging When Using GEMINI_API_KEY

body.zh-TW: 用自己的 `GEMINI_API_KEY`（直接呼叫模型的個人金鑰）連線，因為沒有帳號額度可查，過去跑 `/usage`、`/quota` 或 `/credits` 會一直載入或顯示空白。現在這三個指令會從自動補全與 `/help` 清單裡拿掉。直接執行它們時，畫面會說明原因並引導你去 AI Studio 查看金鑰用量；在 `-p` 執行時，則會回傳結束碼 2 並退出。⟦拿單次儲值卡去結帳，螢幕原本還讓你點會員紅利查詢，結果卡在轉圈圈；現在櫃檯直接把這幾顆按鈕從選單拿掉，硬按的話也會請你改去發卡處看明細。⟧
body.en: When connecting with your own `GEMINI_API_KEY` (a personal key for calling models directly), running `/usage`, `/quota`, or `/credits` used to spin forever or show a blank screen because there is no account quota to display. These three commands are now removed from autocomplete and the `/help` list. Running them directly explains why and directs you to AI Studio to check key usage, while running in `-p` mode exits with code 2. ⟦Imagine paying with a single-use prepaid card while the checkout screen still lets you tap a loyalty points check that just spins endlessly, so the counter removes those buttons from the menu and tells you to check details with the card issuer if you press them anyway.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/usage`, `/quota`, and `/credits` loading forever or showing an empty quota when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, which has no account quota to show; they are now left out of autocomplete and `/help`, running one explains why and points you to the key's usage in AI Studio, and in `-p` runs they exit with code 2.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁版修好較大附件上傳失敗
title.en: Fixed Larger Attachment Uploads Failing in Remote Control Browser View

body.zh-TW: 想把照片或影片夾帶傳給 AI，過去只要檔案超過幾 MB 就會卡住送不出去。這個問題在遠端控制網頁版已經修好，現在最大 20 MB 的附件都能正常上傳。
body.en: When attaching photos or videos to send to the AI, files larger than a few MB used to get stuck and fail to upload. This is now fixed in the Remote Control browser view, and attachments up to 20 MB upload normally.

items.original: Fixed files larger than a few megabytes, such as photos and videos, failing to upload when you attach them in the Remote Control browser view; attachments up to 20 MB now upload.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁修好長對話點選引用沒反應
title.en: Fixed Clicking Quotes in Long Remote Control Conversations Doing Nothing

body.zh-TW: 跟 AI 聊了很多輪之後，想點開自己訊息裡摘錄的舊段落回頭對照，如果那段話在太前面還沒載入，以前畫面會完全不動。這個問題在遠端控制網頁版已經修好，現在畫面會先載入那一段對話，再捲動到引用的位置。
body.en: After chatting with the AI for many turns, clicking a quoted passage in your own message to jump back for reference used to do nothing if that passage was too far back to have loaded yet. This is now fixed in the Remote Control browser view, which loads that part of the conversation first and then scrolls to the quoted spot.

items.original: Fixed clicking a quote in one of your messages in the Remote Control browser view doing nothing when the quoted passage was too far back in a long conversation to have loaded yet; the view now loads that part of the conversation and scrolls to the passage.

title.zh-TW: 安裝 CLI 不再把例行進度誤印成錯誤
title.en: CLI Installation No Longer Prints Routine Progress as Errors

body.zh-TW: 安裝 CLI（命令列介面工具）的過程中，過去明明裝得順利，畫面上卻會冒出以 `ERROR: logging before google.Init` 開頭的例行進度訊息，讓人誤以為安裝失敗。這個問題已經修好，例行進度不再被印成這串錯誤字樣。
body.en: During installation of the CLI (command-line interface tool), routine progress messages starting with `ERROR: logging before google.Init` used to appear even when everything installed smoothly, making it look like the setup had failed. This is now fixed so routine progress is no longer printed with that error prefix.

items.original: Fixed installing the CLI printing routine progress messages as lines starting with `ERROR: logging before google.Init`, which made a successful install look like it had failed.

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器支援動態產生請求標頭
title.en: MCP servers support dynamic request headers

body.zh-TW: 連接外部工具，不想把請求標頭寫死在設定裡，可以交給指令動態提供。現在設定 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，可以指定 `headers_helper` 指令，由它提供動態請求標頭。
body.en: When connecting to external tools, you can let a command provide request headers dynamically instead of hardcoding them in the config. When configuring an MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server, you can now specify a `headers_helper` command to supply dynamic request headers.

items.original: MCP servers can now specify a `headers_helper` command to provide dynamic request headers

title.zh-TW: 只有 Tab 鍵能切回暫置卡片與審核
title.en: Only Tab returns to parked cards and approvals

body.zh-TW:
把卡片暫時擱在一旁，或準備回到先前看到一半的計畫審核畫面時，按其他按鍵已經沒有反應。現在只有 `Tab` 鍵能切回暫置的卡片或計畫審核。

⟦以前書桌旁好幾個按鈕都能把暫存的文件夾叫回桌面，現在改只留一顆專屬呼叫鍵，要調閱擱置的資料只認這一顆。⟧
body.en:
Other keys no longer respond when you want to pull back a card you set aside or return to a plan approval screen you were reviewing. Now only the `Tab` key returns to a parked card or plan approval.

⟦Previously, several buttons by the desk could call a held folder back to the tabletop, but now only one dedicated call button remains for pulling up set-aside files.⟧

items.original: Tab is now the only key that returns to a parked card or plan approval

title.zh-TW: Windows 語音聽寫會指引開啟麥克風
title.en: Windows voice dictation points to microphone access

body.zh-TW: 想靠說話輸入文字卻沒反應，往往是作業系統擋下了收音權限。過去被系統攔截時只能自己摸索設定頁，現在畫面會直接告訴你要去哪裡打開麥克風存取權。
body.en: When speaking to enter text gets no response, the operating system has often blocked audio permissions. Previously you had to hunt through settings on your own when blocked by the system, but now the screen tells you directly where to turn on microphone access.

items.original: Voice dictation on Windows now tells you where to turn on microphone access when the OS blocks it

title.zh-TW: 啟動並行處理查詢讓第一畫面更快出現
title.en: Parallel startup queries speed up the first frame

body.zh-TW:
打開 Grok Build，等待第一個畫面出現的時間縮短了。現在啟動程式會一邊送出終端機協定查詢，一邊建立代理程式連線，不用等前一步做完，第一畫面就能更快出現。

用內嵌或精簡模式啟動時，遇到回應游標位置查詢特別慢的終端機，也不會再拖慢第一畫面的顯示速度。

⟦就像進餐廳點餐，以前一定要等服務生先抄完桌號才肯通知廚房開火；現在點菜跟廚房備料同步進行，第一道菜自然更快上桌。⟧
body.en:
Opening Grok Build now takes less time before the first frame appears. Startup now sends terminal protocol queries at the same time as it establishes the agent connection, so the first frame shows up faster without waiting for the prior step to finish.

When starting in inline or minimal mode, terminals that answer cursor position queries slowly no longer delay the first frame from appearing.

⟦Think of ordering at a restaurant: before, the kitchen would not fire up until the waiter finished writing down the table number, whereas now taking the order and prepping the food happen in parallel so the first dish arrives sooner.⟧

items.original:
Startup now overlaps terminal protocol queries with the agent connection for a faster first frame
Inline and minimal mode startup no longer delays the first frame on terminals that answer the cursor question slowly

title.zh-TW: 額度撞上限切換模型會寫明並套用設定
title.en: Limit-hit model switches show and apply exact settings

body.zh-TW:
對話聊到一半跳出用量上限通知，想按提示換一個模型繼續問，以前選項上看不出會套用哪組參數，切過去也不見得吻合建議值。

現在額度達到上限要切換模型時，按鈕會寫清楚即將選用的確切設定，例如 `Switch to Auto (Standard, Terse)`。確認從上限視窗切換後，也會直接套用後端建議的那一組設定。

⟦你搭計程車遇到管制改道時，以前司機只說換條路走卻沒講路線；現在導航會先亮出完整的新路線名稱，按下確認就照那條走。⟧
body.en:
When a usage limit notice pops up mid-conversation and you follow the prompt to switch models, the option used to hide which parameters would apply and switching did not always match the suggested values.

Now when switching models at a limit hit, the button spells out the exact settings it will select, such as `Switch to Auto (Standard, Terse)`. After confirming the switch from the limit box, it also directly applies the exact settings suggested by the backend.

⟦Picture taking a taxi during a road detour: before, the driver only said to take another way without naming the route, whereas now the navigation shows the full new route name upfront and follows it once you confirm.⟧

items.original:
Limit-box model switch now applies the exact settings the backend suggested
Limit-hit model switches now show the exact settings they will select (for example "Switch to Auto (Standard, Terse)")

title.zh-TW: 空白 hook 檔不報錯且保留首屏提示列
title.en: Empty hook files load cleanly and keep initial rows

body.zh-TW:
剛建立好 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）設定檔，裡面還沒寫規則、只留了空白，以前載入這類檔案會報錯。現在空的或只有空白字元的 hook 檔都能順利載入，不再出錯。

進到第一道提示詞畫面時，只要頁面空間還裝得下，先前的列例如 hook 備註就會留在畫面上，不會一進輸入就消失。
body.en:
When you just created a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) config file with no rules yet and only whitespace, loading it used to throw an error. Now empty or whitespace-only hook files load without error.

When entering the first prompt screen, earlier rows such as hook notes stay visible as long as they fit on the page, instead of disappearing as soon as you start entering input.

items.original:
An empty or whitespace-only hook file now loads without error
The first prompt now keeps earlier rows (such as hook notes) visible when they fit on the page

title.zh-TW: 載入舊工作階段保住模型設定且不卡回合
title.en: Loaded sessions keep model settings and no longer wait on ended turns

body.zh-TW:
打開先前存好的工作階段繼續作業，不用擔心剛打開時抓不到清單就蓋掉設定。就算第一次取得模型清單失敗，載入的工作階段仍會保留已儲存的模型與思考強度。

遇到已經結束的已儲存回合，終端機介面也不會再繼續空等。
body.en:
When you open a previously saved session to continue working, you no longer have to worry about losing settings if the list cannot be fetched right away. Even if the first model list fetch fails, loaded sessions still keep their saved model and effort.

When encountering a saved turn that has already ended, the terminal interface no longer waits idly on it.

items.original:
Loaded sessions now keep their saved model and effort even if the first model list fetch fails
The TUI no longer waits on a saved turn that has already ended

title.zh-TW: MCP 表單與網址拒絕卡片完整顯示內容
title.en: MCP form and URL rejection cards show full content

body.zh-TW:
精簡模式下的 MCP 表單卡片現在會貼合它所繪製的寬度，每個輸入欄位都能留在畫面上。

就算網址遭拒的錯誤原因長到換成兩行，MCP 網址拒絕卡片還是會把遭到拒絕的完整網址整個顯示出來。
body.en:
The MCP form card in minimal mode now fits the width it draws, keeping every input field visible on screen.

Even when the error reason for a rejected URL wraps to two rows, the MCP URL rejection card still displays the full rejected URL.

items.original:
The MCP form card in minimal mode now fits the width it draws, so every field stays visible
The MCP URL rejection card now shows the full rejected URL even when the error reason wraps to two rows

title.zh-TW: 角色設定的多行反白與標籤顯示修正
title.en: Persona multi-line highlights and badge display fixes

body.zh-TW:
打開 `/agents` 視窗調整角色設定，選到哪一行、還剩多少指令沒展開，現在一眼就分得出來。

選取角色設定裡的多行欄位時，每一行都會一併亮起反白。折疊起來的指令說明提示，現在也會顯示真正還剩下幾行。

切換到 `/agents` 視窗的 Personas 分頁後，徽章會依作用範圍區分顏色。如果工具或提示詞延伸欄位沒有內容，畫面會直接寫著 `(empty)`。

⟦就像整理資料夾時把整疊紙用螢光筆畫齊、再貼上分色標籤，以前要自己猜還剩幾頁或是不是空的，現在一眼就能看穿。⟧
body.en:
When you open the `/agents` modal to adjust persona settings, it is now clear at a glance which row is selected and how many instruction lines remain collapsed.

Selecting a multi-line field in a persona now highlights every row. The collapsed-instructions hint also displays the true remaining line count.

After switching to the Personas tab in the `/agents` modal, badges are colored by scope. If tool or prompt-extension fields have no content, the screen reads `(empty)`.

⟦Like tidying up a folder by highlighting a whole stack of pages evenly and adding color-coded tabs, you no longer have to guess how many pages are left or whether a section is blank.⟧

On the `/agents` modal the Personas tab now colors badges by scope, and empty tool or prompt-extension fields read (empty)

title.zh-TW: 窄視窗優先留住資料夾並截斷過長名稱
title.en: Narrow terminals preserve folder names and truncate long model or mode names

body.zh-TW:
終端機視窗拉窄，或選了名稱特別長的模型與模式，畫面頂端和輸入框很容易被字串撐爆。

現在輸入框邊框與模式橫幅遇到過長的模型或模式名稱時，會改用刪節號截斷收尾。

在窄終端機開啟歡迎列時，會先縮短分支名稱，優先保住目前所在的資料夾名稱不被擠掉。
body.en:
When the terminal window is narrowed or a model or mode has an especially long name, the top of the screen and the prompt box can easily overflow.

Now the prompt border and mode banner truncate overly long model or mode names with an ellipsis.

When opening the welcome bar on narrow terminals, the branch name is shortened first to keep the current folder name visible.

items.original:
Prompt border and mode banner now truncate long model or mode names with an ellipsis
Welcome bar on narrow terminals keeps the current folder name visible by shortening the branch first

title.zh-TW: 連結手型游標不閃跳與載入動畫提示
title.en: Steady Link Hand Pointer and Loading Indicator

body.zh-TW:
滑鼠停在連結上按 `Cmd`，或是等待檔案搜尋與圖片預覽跑出來，現在都能看到明確的游標與狀態回饋。

游標停在連結上方時，無論按下或放開 `Cmd` 鍵，都會持續維持手型指標。

搜尋檔案、開啟歷史紀錄和預覽圖片時，畫面上都會出現動態的 `Loading…` 提示。
body.en:
Hovering over a link while pressing `Cmd`, or waiting for file search and image previews to load, now gives you clear cursor and status feedback.

Links keep showing the hand pointer when `Cmd` is pressed or released while the pointer rests on them.

File search, history, and image preview now show an animated `Loading…` indicator.

items.original:
Links keep showing the hand pointer when Cmd is pressed or released while the pointer rests on them
File search, history and image preview now show an animated "Loading…" indicator

title.zh-TW: /doctor 與 /usage 顯示文字修正
title.en: Text Fixes for /doctor and /usage

body.zh-TW:
跑診斷檢查鍵盤設定或查看各模型花費了多少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），兩個常用指令的文字輸出都已修正。

輸入 `/doctor` 檢查環境時，遇到已經確認過、但實際上並沒有啟用的鍵盤協定，現在會正確指出它並未投入使用。

查看 `/usage` 依模型分列的用量明細時，每列後方的計量文字統一改為小寫的 `tokens`，跟其他地方格式一致。

⟦水電帳單校對好之後就是這樣，以前錶頭沒在跑卻沒講實話、單位大小寫還各寫各的，現在狀態報得準、寫法也統一了。⟧
body.en:
When running diagnostics on your keyboard setup or checking how many tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by) each model used, the text output for both common commands is now fixed.

When you run `/doctor` to check your environment, it now correctly says when a confirmed keyboard protocol is not actually in use.

When viewing the `/usage` by-model breakdown, each row now uses lowercase `tokens` for consistency with the rest of the interface.

⟦A reconciled utility bill works the same way: before, it failed to admit when a meter was idle and mixed up unit capitalization, whereas now both the status and the wording are accurate and consistent.⟧

items.original:
`/doctor` now correctly says when a confirmed keyboard protocol is not actually in use
`/usage` by-model rows now say "tokens" in lowercase for consistency

title.zh-TW: Tasks 窗格排版與點選操作多項修復
title.en: Tasks Pane Layout and Selection Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在窄終端機開啟 Tasks 窗格挑任務來操作，以前畫面容易錯位，按鍵跟滑鼠也常常選錯對象。

現在按鈕和計時器不會再蓋到狀態圖示上。篩選後，每一列的圖示、時間跟按鈕也會老實待在各自那一列，不會跑版。

用鍵盤操作時，動作會直接套用到反白的那一列。把窗格往下捲動再點選，也會準確選中游標底下的任務。

搜尋列不會再莫名其妙消失，更新篩選條件後也不會殘留過時的舊列。點到搜尋列或篩選狀態列時，更不會誤選到被藏起來的任務。

⟦修好這塊面板就像把錯位的電梯按鍵板重新對齊，以前按鈕疊在一起、按這格卻跳去別層，現在指哪裡就穩穩點中哪裡。⟧
body.en:
Opening the Tasks pane on a narrow terminal to pick a task used to cause layout misalignment, and keyboard or mouse actions often hit the wrong item.

Buttons and timers no longer paint over the status icon. After filtering, each row's icon, time, and buttons stay on their own row without breaking layout.

Keyboard actions now apply directly to the highlighted row. Clicking after scrolling the pane down also accurately selects the task under the pointer.

The search bar no longer disappears unexpectedly, and updating a filter no longer leaves stale rows behind. Clicking the search bar or filter status row no longer selects a hidden task either.

⟦Realigning a crooked elevator button panel captures this fix: buttons once overlapped and pressing one slot sent you to a different floor, but now wherever you point, it reliably hits the right spot.⟧

items.original: Tasks pane on narrow terminals no longer paints buttons or timers over the status icon; filtering keeps each row's icon, time and buttons on its own row; keys act on the highlighted row; clicks in a scrolled pane select the task under the pointer; the pane no longer loses its search bar, shows stale rows after a filter update, or selects a hidden task when clicking the search or filter status row

title.zh-TW: /tasks 與 /queue 輸出及窗格導覽更新
title.en: /tasks and /queue Output and Pane Navigation Updates

body.zh-TW:
查看任務排程、待辦事項或指令佇列時，各個區塊的顯示格式與隱藏後的鍵盤切換都已補齊一致。

`/tasks` 區塊顯示排程迴圈時，現在會套用跟 Tasks 窗格相同的下次觸發後綴與空白狀態訊息。

todo、tasks 與 queue 這三個窗格就算在隱藏狀態下內容有變動，切回來後鍵盤方向鍵操作依然正常。

`/queue` 的輸出現在會在 bash 指令前面加上 `! ` 前綴，並改用跟窗格相同的行數後綴。
body.en:
When checking scheduled tasks, to-dos, or the command queue, display formatting across blocks and keyboard navigation after hiding a pane are now consistent.

The `/tasks` block now displays scheduled loops with the same next-fire suffix and empty-state message as the Tasks pane.

Even if the todo, tasks, and queue panes change while hidden, arrow-key navigation works properly once you switch back.

`/queue` output now prefixes bash commands with `! ` and uses the same line-count suffix as the pane.

items.original:
The `/tasks` block now shows scheduled loops with the same next-fire suffix and empty message as the Tasks pane
Keyboard navigation in todo, tasks and queue panes now works correctly after the pane changes while hidden
`/queue` output now prefixes bash commands with "! " and uses the pane's line-count suffix

title.zh-TW: 捲動紀錄與區塊檢視器的顯示與選取修復
title.en: Scrollback and Block Viewer Display and Selection Fixes

body.zh-TW:
往回捲動看先前的任務紀錄，或在區塊檢視器搜尋內文，現在每一行都能完整看清。

捲動紀錄現在會把相同的選取反白樣式套用到 Task、Subagent 與 Workflow 這幾類項目列上。

在窄終端機看捲動紀錄時，折行的文字內容跟分組標題也不會再無故漏掉。

開啟區塊檢視器搜尋內文時，搜尋列與狀態列不會再重疊遮住底部的內容行。
body.en:
When scrolling back through earlier task records or searching inside the block viewer, every line is now clearly visible.

Scrollback now applies the same selection highlight to Task, Subagent, and Workflow rows.

Scrollback on narrow terminals no longer drops wrapped text or group headers.

When searching inside the block viewer, the search bar and status bar no longer overlap the bottom lines of content.

items.original:
Scrollback now applies the same selection highlight to Task, Subagent and Workflow rows
Block viewer search bar and status no longer overlap the last lines of content
Scrollback on narrow terminals no longer drops wrapped text or group headers

title.zh-TW: 佈景主題邊框與提示文字的配色調整
title.en: Theme Border and Hint Text Color Adjustments

body.zh-TW:
不論你偏好深色還是淺色終端機配色，介面上的邊框、提示字與反白底色現在都搭得起來。

Tokyo Night 主題在輸入框未聚焦時，邊框現在會正確淡暗下來。

操作提示與已經回答過的問題文字，現在也會跟著終端機佈景主題一起調暗。

在淺色佈景主題下，歡迎畫面的項目列改用較淺的選取與滑鼠懸停顏色。
body.en:
Whether you prefer a dark or light terminal palette, borders, hint text, and highlight backgrounds now match cleanly.

The Tokyo Night theme now dims the unfocused input border correctly.

Tips and answered-question text now dim to match the terminal theme.

On light themes, welcome screen rows now use lighter selection and hover colors.

items.original:
Tokyo Night theme now dims the unfocused input border correctly
Tips and answered-question text now dim to match the terminal theme
Welcome screen rows on light themes now use lighter selection and hover colors

title.zh-TW: 主控面板指令開放與操作體驗更新
title.en: Dashboard Command Support and Interaction Updates

body.zh-TW:
主控面板開著的時候，查閱說明指令、辨識選項與貼上圖片都比以前直接。

現在主控面板處於啟用狀態時，直接輸入 `/release-notes`、`/docs` 與 `/help` 都能順利打開對應內容。

主控面板的預覽窗格在標記選中的權限或提問選項時，會改用跟其他畫面一樣的插入符號與底色帶。

主控面板的操作按鈕現在標為 `Resume Session` 與 `Enable Worktree`。自由輸入列則改顯示 `Type your answer here`。

在主控面板貼上圖片時，圖片會直接附著到正確的輸入欄位，不用再等其他欄位。
body.en:
While the dashboard is open, opening help commands, spotting selected options, and pasting images are all more direct.

When the dashboard is active, entering `/release-notes`, `/docs`, and `/help` now opens their corresponding content.

The dashboard peek pane now highlights the selected permission or question option with the same caret and band used elsewhere.

Dashboard action buttons are now labeled `Resume Session` and `Enable Worktree`. The free-text row now says `Type your answer here`.

Pasted images on the dashboard now attach directly to the correct input field without waiting for other fields.

items.original:
`/release-notes`, `/docs` and `/help` now open when the dashboard is active
The dashboard peek now highlights the selected permission or question option with the same caret and band used elsewhere
Dashboard now labels actions "Resume Session" and "Enable Worktree", and the free-text row says "Type your answer here"
Pasted images now attach to the correct input field on the dashboard without waiting for other fields

title.zh-TW: /resume 與工作階段選擇器排版與防誤觸
title.en: /resume and Session Picker Layout and Accidental-Input Fixes

body.zh-TW:
搜尋並切回先前的工作階段，在窄終端機或精簡模式下常會碰到顯示遮擋或選錯列的問題。

在窄終端機打開 `/resume` 搜尋列時，篩選條件標籤不會再蓋住你打的搜尋字，寬度足夠時也會秀出目前啟用的來源篩選器。

精簡模式的 `/resume` 現在只讓方向鍵與 Enter 作用於實際顯示的列，並套用跟完整選擇器一樣的載入轉圈圖示與空白狀態。它會用跟按鍵一致的查詢條件保留訊息文字相符的結果，關掉工作階段分組時則改畫平面清單，讓選取位置跟按鍵對得上。

工作階段的目前資料夾路徑在窄寬度折行時，`/resume` 面板依然會顯示所有欄位。如果過長的工作目錄路徑前段帶有空白字元，`/resume` 跟全螢幕選擇器也不會再截斷卡片。

清單還在重新載入期間，工作階段選擇器不會再讓按鍵或點擊觸發選取。在下一幀畫面實際繪製出清單列之前，按鍵也不會有反應。
body.en:
Searching for and switching back to a previous session on narrow terminals or in minimal mode often ran into obscured text or wrong-row selection.

On narrow terminals, the `/resume` search bar no longer lets the filter chip cover your query text, and it shows which source filter is active when width permits.

In minimal mode, `/resume` now lets arrow keys and Enter act only on rows that are actually shown, and uses the same loading spinner and empty states as the full picker. It keeps message-text matches visible using the same query the keys use, and draws a flat list when session grouping is off so selection lines up with key presses.

The `/resume` panel now shows all fields even when a session's current folder path wraps at narrow widths. If a long working directory path contains an early space, `/resume` and full-screen pickers no longer truncate cards.

While the list is still reloading, the session picker no longer lets key presses or clicks trigger a selection. Keys also do nothing until the next frame actually draws the list rows.

items.original:
`/resume` search bar on narrow terminals no longer lets the filter chip cover the query text, and now shows which source filter is active when width permits
`/resume` in minimal mode now lets arrow keys and Enter act only on rows that are actually shown, shows the same loading spinner and empty states as the full picker, keeps message-text matches visible using the same query the keys use, and draws a flat list when session grouping is off so selection matches the keys
`/resume` panel now shows all fields even when a session's CWD wraps at narrow widths, and `/resume` and full-screen pickers no longer truncate cards when a long CWD contains an early space
Session picker no longer lets keys or clicks act on sessions while reloading the list, and keys now do nothing until the next frame actually draws list rows

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式登入與互動提示畫面修復
title.en: Minimal Mode Sign-In and Prompt Screen Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在精簡模式登入帳號、確認信任或拒絕計畫修改，原本容易卡住或對不齊的訊息都已整理好。

媒體列移除精簡模式下點不了的 `[Open]` 按鈕，狀態與資訊列結尾改加上刪節號，逐字稿進度也改用句首大寫。

拒絕修改計畫時，精簡模式現在會直接顯示拒絕訊息，不再讓審核卡在空白狀態。

精簡模式登入失敗時只會用紅字顯示錯誤訊息，裝置代碼會單獨顯示並把說明放在下方，在得知登入流程前先寫 `Connecting…`，在窄終端機上也能整齊換行。

信任詢問提示裡的 `y/n` 後方，現在改為單一空白間隔。
body.en:
Signing in, confirming trust, or refusing a plan revision in minimal mode used to leave messages stuck or misaligned, and those are now cleaned up.

Media rows no longer show the `[Open]` button that cannot be clicked in minimal mode, status and info rows now end with an ellipsis, and transcript progress uses sentence case.

When refusing a plan revision, minimal mode now displays the refusal message directly instead of leaving the review stuck in a blank state.

On sign-in failure in minimal mode, only the error message appears in red; the device code is shown on its own with the caption underneath, `Connecting…` is shown until the flow type is known, and text wraps cleanly on narrow terminals.

In the trust prompt, `y/n` is now followed by single spacing.

items.original:
Minimal mode no longer shows an [Open] button on media rows, which that mode cannot click, and status and info rows now end in an ellipsis; transcript progress uses sentence case
Plan revise refusals now appear in minimal mode instead of leaving the review stuck with no message
Sign-in in minimal mode now shows only the error message in red on failure, shows the device code by itself with the caption underneath, shows "Connecting…" until the flow type is known, and wraps cleanly on narrow terminals
Trust question keys in minimal mode now read with single spacing after y/n

title.zh-TW: 權限與提問卡片的箭頭與捲軸修正
title.en: Permission and Question Card Arrow and Scrollbar Fixes

body.zh-TW:
遇到需要授權或回答選擇題的卡片，按鍵方向指示、長輸入文字跟右側捲軸現在都會對得剛剛好。

權限與提問卡片在窄終端機顯示過長的手打回答或表單值時，結尾會改用刪節號收尾。

權限卡片現在只會亮出還能繼續切換範圍的方向箭頭。下方的快捷鍵列也會精準對齊上面那張權限卡片列出的範圍箭頭。

提問卡片的選項說明依卡片寬度折行後，捲軸尺寸會跟著正確計算。如果所有選項一頁就裝得下，選項清單就不再顯示捲軸，也不會讓畫面過度捲動。
body.en:
On permission and question cards, key direction indicators, long typed text, and the right-hand scrollbar now line up properly.

On narrow terminals, permission and question cards now end long typed answers and form values with an ellipsis.

Permission cards now show only the scope arrows that can still move the scope. The shortcuts bar below also aligns precisely with the scope arrows listed on the permission card above it.

In question cards, scrollbar size is now calculated accurately after option descriptions wrap to the card width. When every option fits on one page, the option list no longer shows a scrollbar or allows overscroll.

items.original:
Permission and question cards now end long typed answers and form values with an ellipsis on narrow terminals
Permission cards now show only the scope arrows that still move the scope
The shortcuts bar now shows exactly the scope arrows the permission card above it names
Scrollbars in question cards now size correctly when option descriptions wrap to the card width
Question option lists no longer show a scrollbar or allow overscroll when every option fits

title.zh-TW: 不支援看圖的模型讀到圖片不再中斷
title.en: Models that cannot view images no longer break when reading images

body.zh-TW:
手邊用的是不能辨識圖片的模型，以前碰到圖片會讓整個工作階段直接中斷。現在不論讀取圖片檔，或從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取得圖片，工作階段都不會再中斷，結果裡只會註明圖片沒有附上。

⟦跟只收純文字的舊款呼叫器一樣，以前收到照片會整台當機，現在只會顯示圖片沒附上，連線不會中斷。⟧
body.en:
If you are using a model that cannot recognize images, encountering an image used to break the entire session. Now, whether you read an image file or get an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool, the session no longer breaks, and the result simply notes that the image was not attached.

⟦Like an old text-only pager that used to crash completely when receiving a photo, it now just shows that the image was not attached without dropping the connection.⟧

title.zh-TW: 編輯器內的代理工作階段無法存檔會跳警告
title.en: Agent sessions in editors warn when they can no longer be saved

body.zh-TW: 你跟 AI 互動到一半，如果這段紀錄沒辦法繼續存下來，以前不會收到任何提示。現在只要工作階段無法再存檔，編輯器就會發出警告。
body.en: If you were in the middle of interacting with AI and the session could no longer be saved, you used to receive no notice. Now, whenever the session can no longer be saved, the editor shows a warning.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.zh-TW: muse exec 的 JSON 附圖也會加編號
title.en: muse exec with JSON also numbers attached images

body.zh-TW: 過去執行 `muse exec --json --image` 帶入圖片，提示詞裡不會幫圖片加上編號。現在它會比照不加 `--json` 的 `muse exec --image`，在提示裡為每張附圖標上 `[Image #N]`。
body.en: Previously, running `muse exec --json --image` to include images did not number them in the prompt. Now, matching `muse exec --image` without `--json`, it labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt.

title.zh-TW: 短句開頭的非英文回答不再被丟棄重寫
title.en: Non-English answers after a short opening message are no longer discarded and rewritten

body.zh-TW:
第一則訊息只打幾個字，原本會讓法文、西班牙文、德文等外語回覆整個作廢重來。現在這些非英文回答都會留住。Muse 只會在你的訊息使用常見英文單字，或你主動要求用英文時，才會把工作階段語言設成英文。

⟦好比手機自動切換輸入法，以前開頭打太短就會把剛寫好的外語整段刪掉換成英文，現在除非出現常見英文詞或你主動要求，否則不會擅自換語言。⟧
body.en:
Typing just a few words in your first message used to cause replies in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages to be discarded and rewritten. Now those non-English answers are kept. Muse only sets the session language to English when your messages use common English words or when you ask for English.

⟦Picture a phone that auto-switches keyboards: previously, a short opening message would wipe out the foreign-language text you just wrote and replace it with English, whereas now it will not switch languages on its own unless common English words appear or you ask for it.⟧

items.original: Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English

title.zh-TW: 壓縮完的工作階段不再回頭重讀全部紀錄
title.en: Compacted sessions no longer re-read their entire log

body.zh-TW: 工作階段剛做完壓縮，以前還會在背景把整份工作階段紀錄從頭再讀過。現在壓縮結束後，這項背景重讀已經取消。
body.en: Right after a session compacted, it used to re-read the entire session log from the beginning in the background. Now, once compaction finishes, that background re-read has been canceled.

items.original: A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

first_title.zh-TW: Agent 遇阻回報與建置除錯流程改進
first_title.en: Improved Agent Blocker Reporting and Build Debugging

entries: **The Windows tray tooltip no longer lists a tool you hid under Hide Sections.** Claude and Codex were always listed, even when hidden, and their lines could push the last tools past Windows' 127-character tooltip limit. A hidden tool's line is now left out; the tool chosen as Tray Display Source stays, because the icon shows its number.

**Menu bar icons are visible again on a dark menu bar.** The Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse icons were drawn black even when the menu bar was dark, so on macOS Tahoe they disappeared against it. They now follow the menu bar's text color in light and dark. Reported in #352.

**The Antigravity card no longer goes stale when only its weekly reading is carried over.** When the weekly reading could not be refreshed, the whole card was marked stale, which stopped the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows its age, and the 5-hour row keeps working.

**Quota notifications no longer use a reading from before the window reset.** After the reset time passed, the old percentage could still send a "used up" notification or block the next window's notifications. On macOS and Windows, a window past its reset time now ends quietly.
**Projects that use only unpriced models show "—" instead of $0.00 in the report,** including after date filtering.
**The Windows tray now reports a failed status line toggle or hook install** instead of failing silently.
**GPT-OSS, which Antigravity retires on 2026-11-18, was removed from the Claude and GPT model group,** and Antigravity group models with hyphenated names now match your usage logs.
**Gemini 4 Carbon now shows as "Carbon 4".**

**Switching to an account without a 5-hour limit no longer keeps the previous account's 5-hour usage.** The status line and quota-aware mode filled the missing window from the old account, so they could show 99% used on an account that has no 5-hour limit. A missing window is now filled only from the same account. The status-line hook updates to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.

**The status line switch shows as on when only Grok uses it beside your own Claude Code status line.** It showed as off, and turning it on installed the status line again instead of turning Grok's off.
**Quota-aware mode no longer announces a Codex model a second time when you first use it.** A model already recorded from the Codex catalog was announced again from your usage logs.

**New Antigravity models are announced even when every model in the first scan was already known from other tools.** usage did not record that Antigravity had been scanned, so later new models were treated as part of the first scan and not announced.

**The offline check works when NO_PROXY excludes Google.** With a proxy set, usage assumed it was online even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, so it could run the Antigravity CLI while offline and mark you as signed out.
**Offline prices for Claude Mythos 5 and Mythos 5.2 were added,** and the price-table check now covers Mythos models.

**A refusal from a separate Codex limit no longer shows your regular Codex quota as 100% used.** When a dedicated limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card marked the regular weekly window as full. Only a refusal of the regular Codex limit does that now.

**Reopening an old Codex session no longer hides newer quota from your other sessions.** After a refusal in a resumed old session, the card kept that session's old reading and skipped newer readings from other sessions. It now takes the newest reading, then applies the refusal.

**The Codex disk cache is no longer rewritten on every refresh when you have forked or subagent sessions.** Those sessions were dropped each time the cache was saved, so the cache was rewritten and they were read again.

**Opening the report no longer leaves the menu bar or tray app about 150 MB larger.** The report was built inside the app, which loaded your full history a second time and kept that memory until restart. It is now built in a separate process that frees the memory when it exits.

**The report is built faster.** It reads Claude Code logs once instead of twice and no longer runs git for project folders that were deleted. On one large history it went from 47 to 32 seconds, with identical numbers.

**Days you used Claude Code count as active in the report even when their conversation files are gone.** Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days counted as idle and broke your streak. Active days and streaks now count them, and the heatmap shows them in its lightest shade. The appendix, now titled "How the numbers are calculated", lists those dates under "Usage not included".

**Older Antigravity history no longer lists one model twice or leaves it unpriced in the report.** History saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`, which left billions of tokens priced at $0. They are now merged with the clean name and priced.

**Usage saved only as daily totals no longer ranks as your top project or tool.** Usage from before August 2026 has no project or tool, and the report listed it as the top "unknown" project and tool at $0.00. It now shows as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row at the bottom with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name. Percentages are unchanged.
**Dispatch conversations started with a slash command get a real title in the report** instead of text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below".
**The Antigravity status line shows the Argon quota for Gemini 4 Argon and Orchestrator (Argon).** It showed the Claude and GPT group or the Gemini group instead.

**Auto-start 5-hour Session is renamed Auto-start 5-hour timer.** It sat under Launch at login and read like a second launch option; it starts the 5-hour timer right after a reset. Behavior and settings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 5 小時額度與通知不被舊讀數拖累
title.en: 5-hour quotas and alerts stay unaffected by old readings

body.zh-TW:
5 小時窗口照理說各自獨立計算，之前只要遇上過期或重置的舊數字，卡片和通知卻常跟著亂套。

Antigravity 週額度更新失敗、只能沿用舊讀數時，過去整張卡會被標成過期，5 小時的燃燒率、通知與窗口保持功能全都停住。現在只有週額度那一列顯示資料放了多久，5 小時那一列照常運作。

額度通知也不再拿重置前的讀數來判斷。過了重置時間後，舊百分比以前還可能發出「已用完」通知，或把下一個窗口的通知擋掉。現在 macOS 與 Windows 上，過了重置時間的窗口都會安靜結束。⟦月票過期本來不該影響買單程票進站，以前舊數字一過期卻把單程閘門也鎖住，現在各算各的互不干擾。⟧
body.en:
Each 5-hour window is supposed to be calculated on its own, yet stale or pre-reset numbers used to throw off both the card and notifications.

When Antigravity failed to refresh its weekly quota and had to carry over an old reading, the entire card was marked stale, stopping the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows how old the data is, while the 5-hour row keeps working.

Quota notifications also stop using readings from before a window reset. Past the reset time, an old percentage could still trigger a "used up" alert or block notifications for the next window. On both macOS and Windows, any window past its reset time now ends quietly. ⟦An expired monthly pass should not stop you from buying a single-ride ticket, yet an expired old number used to lock the single-ride gate as well—now each runs on its own without getting in the way.⟧

items.original:
**The Antigravity card no longer goes stale when only its weekly reading is carried over.** When the weekly reading could not be refreshed, the whole card was marked stale, which stopped the 5-hour burn rate, notifications, and the window keeper. Now only the weekly row shows its age, and the 5-hour row keeps working.
**Quota notifications no longer use a reading from before the window reset.** After the reset time passed, the old percentage could still send a "used up" notification or block the next window's notifications. On macOS and Windows, a window past its reset time now ends quietly.

title.zh-TW: 報表未定價與舊紀錄不再誤標 $0
title.en: Unpriced and old report entries no longer show $0

body.zh-TW:
打開報表看到好幾個專案寫著 $0.00，還有一筆「unknown」排在榜首，很容易誤以為沒花到錢或這項目最燒額度。

只用到未定價模型的專案，現在一律改顯示橫線而不是 $0.00，套用日期篩選後也一樣。

模型 ID 整理前留下的舊 Antigravity 歷史，曾保有像 `gemini-3.8-flash-n` 這類原始 ID。這讓同個模型在報表被列兩次，數十億個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）也被算成 $0。現在這批紀錄會併回整理後的名稱並計價。

2026 年 8 月以前只存下每日總量的用量沒有專案和工具資料，以前被當成「unknown」以 $0.00 排第一。現在它改成排在最底下灰色的「舊紀錄（只剩總數）」，金額顯示未知，趨勢圖圖例也用同一個名稱，百分比不變。
body.en:
Opening the report to find several projects listed at $0.00 and an "unknown" entry at the top makes it easy to think nothing was spent or that it burned the most quota.

Projects that use only unpriced models now show "—" instead of $0.00, including after date filtering.

Older Antigravity history saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`. That caused the same model to appear twice in the report and left billions of tokens (the text units AI processes and bills for) priced at $0. Those records are now merged into the clean name and priced.

Usage saved only as daily totals before August 2026 has no project or tool data, and it used to rank first as "unknown" at $0.00. It now appears at the bottom as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name while percentages stay unchanged.

items.original:
**Projects that use only unpriced models show "—" instead of $0.00 in the report,** including after date filtering.
**Older Antigravity history no longer lists one model twice or leaves it unpriced in the report.** History saved before model IDs were cleaned up kept raw IDs such as `gemini-3.8-flash-n`, which left billions of tokens priced at $0. They are now merged with the clean name and priced.
**Usage saved only as daily totals no longer ranks as your top project or tool.** Usage from before August 2026 has no project or tool, and the report listed it as the top "unknown" project and tool at $0.00. It now shows as a grey "Old records (totals only)" row at the bottom with an unknown cost, and the trend legend uses the same name. Percentages are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列開關與跨帳號用量不再錯亂
title.en: Status line switch and cross-account usage stop mixing up

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 點了狀態列沒反應，或是換完帳號發現額度百分比還停在舊帳號那邊。

在 Windows 系統匣切換狀態列或安裝 hook（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）失敗時，現在會直接跳出錯誤提示，不再悄悄沒反應。

換到沒有 5 小時額度的帳號後，狀態列與額度感知模式不再沿用前一個帳號的 5 小時用量。以前這兩個功能會拿舊帳號數字補缺口，讓原本沒有 5 小時額度的帳號顯示成 99% 已用。現在只會用同一個帳號的資料補窗口，狀態列 hook 已更新為 1.19，額度感知 hook 更新為 1.17。

當你讓 Claude Code 用自己的狀態列、只留 Grok 用 usage 的狀態列時，開關現在會正確顯示為開啟。原本它會顯示關閉，按下去反而重新安裝狀態列，而不是關掉 Grok 那邊。
body.en:
Clicking the status line in Windows could do nothing, or switching accounts could leave your quota percentage stuck on the old account.

When toggling the status line or installing a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) fails in the Windows tray, it now shows an error instead of failing silently.

After switching to an account without a 5-hour limit, the status line and quota-aware mode no longer carry over the previous account's 5-hour usage. They used to fill the missing window with numbers from the old account, making an account with no 5-hour limit show 99% used. A missing window is now filled only from the same account, with the status-line hook updated to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.

When Claude Code uses its own status line and only Grok uses usage's status line, the switch now correctly shows as on. It previously showed as off, and clicking it reinstalled the status line instead of turning Grok's off.

items.original:
**The Windows tray now reports a failed status line toggle or hook install** instead of failing silently.
**Switching to an account without a 5-hour limit no longer keeps the previous account's 5-hour usage.** The status line and quota-aware mode filled the missing window from the old account, so they could show 99% used on an account that has no 5-hour limit. A missing window is now filled only from the same account. The status-line hook updates to 1.19 and the quota-aware hook to 1.17.
**The status line switch shows as on when only Grok uses it beside your own Claude Code status line.** It showed as off, and turning it on installed the status line again instead of turning Grok's off.

title.zh-TW: 新舊模型分組與 Mythos 離線定價對齊

title.zh-TW: 新模型偵測不再重複或漏掉提醒
title.en: New model detection stops repeating or missing alerts

body.zh-TW:
有時才剛看過新模型登場提示，轉頭用 Codex 又再跳一次；換成 Antigravity 推出新模型卻安安靜靜沒通知。

在額度感知模式下，Codex 模型目錄已經記錄過的模型，第一次實際用到時不再從用量紀錄重複提醒一次。

如果第一次掃描 Antigravity 時裡面的模型都已從其他工具認得，usage 現在會記下已經掃描過。往後有新模型出現就不會被當成第一次掃描的一部分，照樣會發出提醒。⟦點名冊就像店裡的熟客名單，以前看過的名單還會重複唱名、沒登記到的新分店又漏掉新客人，現在都只為真正第一次上門的新面孔報到。⟧
body.en:
Sometimes a new-model alert popped up again right after you used Codex, while an actual new Antigravity model triggered no notification at all.

In quota-aware mode, a model already recorded in the Codex catalog is no longer announced a second time from usage logs when you first use it.

If every model in the first Antigravity scan was already known from other tools, usage now records that the scan took place. Later new models will no longer be treated as part of that first scan and will still be announced. ⟦Think of the roster as a shop's list of regulars: names already on the list used to get called out twice, while an unregistered new branch missed its new arrivals—now only genuine first-time visitors get announced.⟧

title.zh-TW: NO_PROXY 排除 Google 時離線不誤判
title.en: Offline check stays accurate when NO_PROXY excludes Google

body.zh-TW: 電腦有設 proxy（代理伺服器，轉接網路連線的中繼站），又把 Google 列進不走代理的 `NO_PROXY` 名單，離線時卻被當成已登出嗎？過去即使 Google 登入主機不經由代理連線，usage 只要看到有設代理就當成有網路，結果在離線時執行 Antigravity CLI，把你標成已登出。現在 Google 登入主機被 NO_PROXY 排除時，離線檢查也會正常運作。⟦就像櫃檯看到你掛了轉接分機就當作外線暢通，沒管直撥號碼不走總機，斷線時直接誤判你離席；現在走直撥也會正常檢查離線狀態。⟧
body.en: Have a proxy (an intermediary server that forwards network connections) configured with Google listed in `NO_PROXY` to bypass it, only to be marked signed out while offline? Previously, even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, usage assumed you were online just because a proxy was set, so running the Antigravity CLI offline could mark you as signed out. Now the offline check works properly when NO_PROXY excludes Google's sign-in host. ⟦Picture a front desk assuming your outside line works just because an extension is set to forward, ignoring that direct-dial numbers bypass the switchboard and marking you away when disconnected—now direct lines get checked for offline status properly too.⟧

items.original: **The offline check works when NO_PROXY excludes Google.** With a proxy set, usage assumed it was online even when Google's sign-in host bypassed the proxy, so it could run the Antigravity CLI while offline and mark you as signed out.

title.zh-TW: Codex 額度與分支對話不再錯算重讀

只是特定模型被擋下，主畫面的週用量卻跟著跳成滿格；從對話切出去的子工作階段也每次都被重頭讀過。

當 Codex Spark 或 premium 模型這類獨立額度拒絕請求時，卡片以前會把一般週額度也標成用完。現在只有一般 Codex 額度被拒，才會顯示成 100% 已用。

When a separate limit such as Codex Spark or a premium model refused a request, the card used to mark the regular weekly quota as exhausted too. Now it only shows 100% used when the regular Codex limit is refused.

After a refusal in a reopened old Codex session, the card previously stayed on that old reading and skipped newer quota readings from other sessions. It now picks the newest reading first, then applies the refusal.

If you have forked sessions or sessions handed off to subagents, the Codex disk cache used to drop them every time it saved. They are no longer left out, avoiding rewriting the cache and rereading them on every refresh.

title.zh-TW: 報表產生更快，記憶體不再久佔
title.en: Reports build faster without holding onto memory

body.zh-TW:
歷史紀錄越積越多，點開用量報表不只得等上一陣子，關掉後電腦記憶體還像被咬住一樣降不下來。

以前報表是在選單列或系統匣 app 裡直接產生，會把完整歷史再讀一次，讓 app 多佔約 150 MB 記憶體直到重開才會還。現在改由獨立行程產生報表，這個行程結束後就會釋放記憶體。

報表讀取速度也變快了，Claude Code 紀錄改成只讀一次，已刪除的專案資料夾也不再跑 git。一份大量歷史實測從 47 秒降到 32 秒，數字完全相同。⟦小店把算帳交給外包會計的工作室：以前厚帳本全攤在店裡櫃檯佔位子，現在帳在外面算完就收工，櫃檯立刻空出來。⟧
body.en:
As history grows, opening the usage report not only took a while, it also left your computer's memory stuck high even after closing it.

Previously, the report was built inside the menu bar or tray app, loading the full history a second time and adding about 150 MB of memory that stayed until restart. The report is now built in a separate process that frees the memory as soon as it exits.

Report loading is faster too: Claude Code logs are now read once instead of twice, and git no longer runs for deleted project folders. On one large history test, build time dropped from 47 to 32 seconds with identical numbers. ⟦A small shop now hands its bookkeeping to an outside accountant's studio: thick ledgers used to stay spread across the shop counter taking up space, whereas now the books are tallied off-site and the counter clears right away.⟧

items.original:
**Opening the report no longer leaves the menu bar or tray app about 150 MB larger.** The report was built inside the app, which loaded your full history a second time and kept that memory until restart. It is now built in a separate process that frees the memory when it exits.
**The report is built faster.** It reads Claude Code logs once instead of twice and no longer runs git for project folders that were deleted. On one large history it went from 47 to 32 seconds, with identical numbers.

title.zh-TW: 超過 30 天被刪的對話仍算活躍日
title.en: Conversations deleted after 30 days still count as active days

body.zh-TW: 每天都在用 Claude Code，回頭看報表的連續天數卻莫名其妙斷在一個月前。Claude Code 預設會在 30 天後刪除對話檔，以前那些日子就被當成沒用過，讓活躍日與連續天數跟著斷掉。現在這兩項都會算進去，熱力圖會用最淺的顏色標示。附錄也改名為「數字怎麼算的」，並在「沒算到的用量」底下把這些日期列出來。⟦跟紙本打卡單滿一個月就碎掉一樣，以前單子一銷毀就把出勤天數歸零，現在總表上仍用淡色補記一筆，全勤紀錄不會平白中斷。⟧
body.en: You use Claude Code every day, yet the streak in your report mysteriously stops a month ago. Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days used to count as unused, breaking both your active days and your streak. Now both are counted, and the heatmap marks them in its lightest shade. The appendix is also renamed to "How the numbers are calculated" and lists those dates under "Usage not included". ⟦Paper timecards used to get shredded after a month, resetting attendance counts to zero when the slips were destroyed, whereas the master sheet now adds a faint mark so a perfect attendance record is not broken for no reason.⟧

items.original: **Days you used Claude Code count as active in the report even when their conversation files are gone.** Claude Code deletes conversation files after 30 days by default, so those days counted as idle and broke your streak. Active days and streaks now count them, and the heatmap shows them in its lightest shade. The appendix, now titled "How the numbers are calculated", lists those dates under "Usage not included".

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令派工對話在報表顯示正常標題
title.en: Slash-command dispatch conversations show proper titles in the report

body.zh-TW: 翻舊紀錄想找先前派出去的任務，畫面上卻冒出「<local-command-caveat>The command below」這串字。過去根本看不出那次在忙什麼，現在用斜線指令開頭的派工對話，報表都會顯示正常的標題。
body.en: When you look through old records to find a task you previously dispatched, text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below" appears on screen. It used to be impossible to tell what that run was doing, whereas dispatch conversations starting with a slash command now display proper titles in the report.

items.original: **Dispatch conversations started with a slash command get a real title in the report** instead of text like "<local-command-caveat>The command below".

title.zh-TW: 5 小時選項改名，工作階段改稱計時器
title.en: 5-hour option renamed, changing Session to timer

body.zh-TW: 設定選單裡有個選項排在「登入時啟動」正下方，看名字常讓人以為是第二個開機啟動開關。它負責的是在額度重置後立刻開始 5 小時計時器。原名「Auto-start 5-hour Session」改為「Auto-start 5-hour timer」，名稱中的「工作階段」換成「計時器」。實際行為和你的既有設定都不會改變。
body.en: In the settings menu, an option sits right below "Launch at login", and its name often made it look like a second startup toggle. What it actually does is start the 5-hour timer right after a quota reset. Originally named "Auto-start 5-hour Session", it is renamed to "Auto-start 5-hour timer", replacing "Session" with "timer" in the name. Actual behavior and your existing settings remain unchanged.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session is renamed Auto-start 5-hour timer.** It sat under Launch at login and read like a second launch option; it starts the 5-hour timer right after a reset. Behavior and settings are unchanged.

## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧
